operations.text: A reported verdict no longer reads as a stop (HARD-022). The Orchestrator rule "a verdict and the next dispatch never share one message" was read as "stop after a verdict" and halted the loop at steps that need no operator word. YOUR ORCHESTRATOR RULES: the first operation re-renders `.claude/aiwf-native/ORCHESTRATOR.md`, where § Verdict and dispatch now reads "a verdict gets its own message, not its own turn" and carries its suppression dual: when the next step needs no operator word, the COO reports the verdict and goes on in the same turn, and the loop halts only where the doctrine puts a halt; if you edited that file, the update asks you, and an artifact you hold through an override is not applied - the new render is recorded as upstream. SUPERSEDED LOCAL RULES: a local memory or rule saying the loop does not stop after a verdict can become a one-line pointer to this section.
